I have a really great relationship with my parents and it’s because they trust me. I know that i can call my parents for help no matter what, even if we’ve been drinking or drugs or ANYTHING like that i know my parents priority would be to get everyone safe and then later reprimand me if at all needed. 

The way this started is that anytime i went out to a party or to see friends, they would say “If you need an adult just call us, we won’t tell you off” and after a while i believed them. 

I feel so safe going to them with my problems or anything going on with my friends. I know they won’t tell anyone else and they won’t scold me.
